questions: Verify ephemeral runs, exec resume/fork, required nullable fields and current sandbox flags.
Compare native compaction with short artifact handoffs using pinned CLI evidence.
decision: Validate Codex as an ephemeral execution protocol with explicit schema and sandbox adaptation; do not infer supported flags from model names.
code_observations: The Codex worker uses exec and ephemeral mode. The completion schema adapter makes optional fields required-nullable for the supported structured-output contract.
run_concise modifies the effective worker prompt and therefore requires composed-entrypoint tests, not only a raw argv golden.

symbols.name: ## Elevation mechanics (how a route is actually obtained)

implementation_steps: Record CLI version/help and model-discovery evidence without starting a paid task; select tested capability branches for exec, structured output and sandbox flags.
Maintain a schema transformation test for nested objects, required nullable fields, additionalProperties and invalid outputs. Refusal or incomplete output is not a passing task.
Keep ephemeral mode for normal cross-task isolation. Same-provider resume/fork is a separate opt-in contract, never a way to transfer private reasoning state to another provider.
Use read-only sandbox for observation/review where supported and verify that output/log paths can still be written only in owned locations.
Parse JSONL events incrementally and preserve the final report independently of progress text. Link deterministic validation evidence through the production prompt.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Schema fixtures remain accepted by the adapter without weakening additionalProperties checks.
Ephemeral default argv and composed static prefix remain stable.
Malformed events, partial final JSON, a nonzero exit and a valid blocked report remain distinguishable.
An unsupported sandbox/effort flag fails preflight instead of falling back to unrestricted execution.
Cache and cost records distinguish reported usage from estimates and do not import outdated no-write-cost assumptions.

alternatives.title: Trust a successful codex process and its narrative
alternatives.tradeoff: Low validation overhead but cannot prove user acceptance.

alternatives.title: Versioned CLI/schema fixtures plus independent checks
alternatives.tradeoff: Small maintenance cost and clear protocol boundaries.

alternatives.title: Implicit session continuation for every retry
alternatives.tradeoff: Changes retention/isolation and can reintroduce unrelated history without measured benefit.

cost_model: Measure accepted outcomes and input/output/cache units. Do not copy API billing rules into subscription estimates without evidence for the actual host route.
unverified: No real Codex invocation or sandbox escape test was executed; fake CLI contract tests cannot certify provider service behavior.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
